lessons_used: Predictions underpredicted gains on winning tests while being overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 4 tests.
home wait_info changes were helpful, winning both tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as they lack at least 2 agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Account Session Persistence Safety Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that signing in preserves your pet across desktop restarts and updates.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights 8 issues where pets were missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints won 3 out of 4 previous tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion data so your pet never resets across desktop app restarts.

guard.reason: Adds a valid sign-in persistence hint on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: sign_in hints won 3 of 4 tests and directly address 8 support tickets.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Stage Companion Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated render preview screen immediately after waiting to show asset compilation progress.
candidates.why: The home stage wait conversion drops to 89.4% with a mean duration of 2336s, and adding visual progress screens reduces drop-off during generation.

new_render_preview.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet Assets
new_render_preview.body: Compiling 3D desktop pet animations and interaction behaviors...

guard.reason: Adds a valid preview screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: New screen requires a full release and major UI redesigns have shown little benefit.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a split layout separating the official pet badge and name input field.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest completion rate in the initial funnel at 66.0% (median 89s), requiring clearer layout hierarchy.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interactive Usage Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive checklist component to the home intro screen detailing mouse controls and desktop pet commands.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop after completing onboarding.

components.text: Click to pet, drag to relocate on desktop, right-click for tray settings

guard.reason: Adds interactive usage instructions to home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step has high drop-off and support issues, but adding a sub-flow requires high build cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Generation Realtime Progress Counter
candidates.change: Enables step counter and completion system notifications on the waiting screen with status body text.
candidates.why: home wait_info changes were successful in both prior tests, mitigating user drop-off during long pet rendering times (median 201s).

waiting.body: Building custom pet animations and initializing desktop physics engine...

guard.reason: Adds valid progress information and notifications to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: home wait_info changes won both past tests (+3.1%) and are simple to configure.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Overview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story onboarding screen using a split layout format with structured option choice cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s and drops to 78.3% conversion, indicating initial story clarity needs redesigning.

guard.reason: 'story.replace.intro_story[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the intro_story job (use ['animation', 'button', 'image', 'mascot', 'text', 'video'])

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Displays a direct hint on the photo upload screen outlining lighting and framing suggestions for accurate pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance results during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit photos with clear subject framing for optimal 3D desktop pet generation.

guard.reason: Adds helpful framing guidance hint on the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 34.0% with support tickets, though specific adoption hint evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: Desktop App Auto-Launch System Notification
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the home intro screen notifying users that the pet is running in the system tray.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 tickets where pets did not appear on desktop or users thought the app failed to open after finishing.

home_intro.hint: Your desktop pet is now live! Access options anytime from your system tray menu.

guard.reason: Adds a valid system tray launch notification hint on the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off and support evidence, but finish notification had only 1 past test (-0.1%).

candidates.title: Path Selection Flexible Switching Hint
candidates.change: Adds a helpful hint on choose_path assuring users they can pick additional pets or switch paths later.
candidates.why: Users take a median of 8s but mean of 514s on path selection, indicating hesitation when choosing their pet route.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry! You can adopt additional desktop pets or change companion paths anytime later.

guard.reason: Adds a path flexibility reassurance hint to choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 prior tests (-0.2%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Quick Authentication Layout Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds sign-in options into a streamlined compact layout with single-click authentication action buttons.
candidates.why: Support reported 2 sign-in screen stall bugs and sign_in step accounts for notable onboarding friction.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

picked: Desktop Rendering Stage Companion Preview Screen

decisions.title: Desktop Rendering Stage Companion Preview Screen
